BiblicalUsage: Semachiah was a son of Shemaiah, one of the strong men of the gatekeepers' families who served in the house of the LORD. He stands in the lists of those who kept the doors and the order of the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God honours the men who kept the gates, and Semachiah's name in that list shows that guarding His house is service too.
